about.title: About Me
intro: Hi! I'm Shubham Rathi, a passionate Full Stack Developer and Computer Vision enthusiast currently pursuing my BTech in Computer Science at Lovely Professional University. I love creating innovative solutions and exploring new technologies.
With experience in React, Node.js, Python, and OpenCV, I've worked on various projects from web applications to computer vision systems. I'm always eager to learn and tackle challenging problems.

items.title: Music App
items.description: A full-featured music streaming application built with React. Users can browse and play music from an extensive online library, create personalized playlists, search for tracks, artists, and albums, and download songs for offline listening. Features include audio controls, volume adjustment, and a responsive design for mobile and desktop.

items.title: LPU UMS
items.description: A comprehensive university management system designed for LPU students. The platform provides access to timetables, academic announcements, exam results, messaging system, and other essential student services. Built with Python and Streamlit for a user-friendly web interface, it simplifies student life by centralizing all academic information in one place.

items.title: Resume Builder
items.description: An intuitive web application that allows users to create professional resumes quickly through a simple form-based interface. The app handles all formatting automatically, supporting multiple templates and export options. Built with React for the frontend and Node.js for the backend, it streamlines the resume creation process for job seekers.

items.title: Hotel Reservation
items.description: A hotel booking platform where users can search for available hotels, compare prices, and make reservations for specific dates. Features include room selection, booking confirmation, and payment integration. Built as a full-stack application with React frontend and Node.js backend.

items.title: Spiritual Mantra
items.description: A wellness application developed for a hackathon with the theme of spirituality. The app provides guided yoga sessions, meditation practices, and spiritual content to promote mental well-being. Features include session timers, progress tracking, and a calming user interface designed to enhance the user's spiritual journey.

items.title: Todo App
items.description: A productivity application for managing daily tasks and to-do lists. Users can add, edit, delete, and mark tasks as completed. Features include categorization, due dates, and local storage for data persistence. Built with React to demonstrate state management and user interaction principles.

items.title: OpenCV
items.description: An innovative AI chatbot created using OpenCV and computer vision technologies. The system allows users to interact naturally by asking questions about my background, experience, skills, and projects - just like interviewing my CV. Features include facial recognition for user identification, natural language processing for conversational interactions, and real-time video processing. Built with Python, OpenCV, and integrated AI models for intelligent responses and visual analysis.
